ADBE.rationale: Recurring creative-software economics deliver 35% operating margins and a 10.0% trailing FCF yield at 14.5x earnings; consecutive margin declines and AI competition threaten durability.

INTU.rationale: Recurring tax/accounting demand, 14% growth and 21x earnings support value; the supplied 9.1% FCF yield includes cash-flow addbacks and capex differs from the company release. AI competition and normalized owner earnings make cheapness provisional.

APH.rationale: 55% growth, 30% operating margins and 18.6x earnings suggest attractive connector economics; company disclosures show materially more debt than the raw snapshot. Acquisition durability, cash conversion and debt reconciliation make cheapness provisional.

BSX.rationale: Medical-device profitability and cash generation support 19x earnings and a 5.2% FCF yield; growth slowing to 7.5% and conflicting debt classifications require care, making cheapness conditional on the quote/share basis.

FIX.rationale: 54% growth, expanding operating margins and a 6.0% FCF yield support 25x earnings; data-center construction exposure and working-capital reversals could make recent cash generation unusually strong.

ANIP.rationale: 26% growth and the supplied 10.9% FCF yield support 14.7x earnings; product concentration and declining cash-flow margins matter. Company guidance identifies $621m principal debt, above the snapshot's $301m carrying input, making cheapness provisional.

BMY.rationale: 14.7x reported earnings and an 8.4% trailing FCF yield offer a meaningful buffer for slower growth; patent expirations, replacement-drug execution and $43bn debt remain the central risks.

NVDA.rationale: 106% growth and 66% quarterly operating margins support exceptional AI economics at 26x reported earnings; the earnings-to-cash gap, export constraints and concentration of customer capex prevent an unqualified cheap assessment.

MSFT.rationale: Enterprise switching costs, 18% growth and 45% operating margins support 27x earnings; a 1.9% FCF yield reflects enormous AI capex, so attractive value depends on investment returns rather than the headline P/E alone.

NFLX.rationale: Content/distribution scale, 35% quarterly operating margins and a 4.1% FCF yield support 19x earnings; slowing growth and an earnings-to-cash gap require normalized content-spending analysis.

MA.rationale: The global payments network converts strong operating margins into cash at 33x earnings; sustained transaction growth supports the premium, but regulation, payment alternatives and a 3.1% FCF yield limit protection.

V.rationale: Global payment-network economics and high cash margins support 34x earnings; stale financial anchors, regulation and alternative rails limit the margin of safety despite resilient transaction growth.

MNST.rationale: Brand/distribution economics, 20% growth and strong cash generation support 21x earnings; incomplete cash-flow coverage, competition and demand durability limit the case for calling the valuation cheap.

LMT.rationale: Defense programs and strong cash generation support 21x earnings and a 6.0% FCF yield; fixed-price contract charges, government-budget exposure and leverage limit the margin of safety.

DXCM.rationale: Recurring glucose-monitoring demand supports 24% operating margins and a 4.5% FCF yield; 31x earnings is reasonable only if adoption and reimbursement remain durable amid competition.

META.rationale: Social-network economics and 26% growth support 22x earnings, but sharply weaker operating margins and AI capex reduce trailing FCF yield to 1.7%; spending returns, regulation and ad cyclicality are decisive.

CRM.rationale: Recurring enterprise software and substantial cash generation support the franchise; 21x reported earnings is flattered by non-operating income, while weaker operating margins, higher debt and incomplete comparable cash-flow coverage warrant caution.

ABNB.rationale: The marketplace combines 17% growth with substantial trailing cash generation at 35x earnings. Travel cyclicality, regulation and incomplete comparable cash-flow inputs make fair value provisional.

SYK.rationale: Medical-device distribution and procedure demand support improving margins and a 4.2% FCF yield at 30x earnings; acquisition integration, leverage and reimbursement constrain the margin of safety.

PODD.rationale: Recurring insulin-pump demand and 24% growth support 28x earnings; weakening quarterly margins and a 2.8% FCF yield leave execution, reimbursement and competition as material constraints.

RGLD.rationale: Royalty/streaming assets provide strong margins and less direct mine-operating exposure at 26x earnings; commodity prices, operator concentration, acquisitions and incomplete capital-spending coverage prevent a cheap assessment.

PEP.rationale: Brand/distribution scale and a 5.6% FCF yield support 17x earnings, but modest structural growth and significant leverage warrant a fair rather than clearly cheap valuation; demand elasticity and input costs remain risks.

UNP.rationale: Rail-network barriers and 41% quarterly operating margins support 23x earnings; a 3.8% FCF yield offers moderate protection against freight cyclicality, labor costs and substantial debt.

AVGO.rationale: 85% growth, 54% quarterly operating margins and substantial FCF support premium semiconductor/software economics; 40x earnings leaves AI concentration, acquisition debt and growth normalization as decisive risks.

SPGI.rationale: Ratings, indices and data franchises support durable margins at 28x earnings; stale financial coverage, issuance cyclicality and regulatory risk keep the premium valuation provisional rather than cheap.

VSEC.rationale: Aviation-services growth and margin improvement are positive, but 59x earnings, weak earnings-to-cash conversion and negative trailing FCF leave acquisition debt, dilution and integration risk insufficiently compensated.

NIBE-B.ST.rationale: Heat-pump demand and cash generation are recovering, but growth remains below 8% after contraction; 34x earnings and meaningful debt demand more durable improvement than the recent cycle demonstrates.

LGND.rationale: Royalty assets provide high cash margins, but non-operating gains inflate reported earnings; 22.8x sales and a 2.0% FCF yield leave limited protection against milestone variability, financing costs and partner concentration.

SITM.rationale: Timing-chip growth and improving margins are promising, but 27x sales and a 0.7% FCF yield price extraordinary expansion; acquisition financing, customer cycles and non-operating gains reduce protection.

DASH.rationale: The delivery network sustains 36% growth and positive FCF, but operating margins remain thin and deteriorating; 94x earnings and a 3.3% FCF yield leave substantial execution and regulatory risk.

BRZE.rationale: 26% subscription growth and positive cash generation show progress, but operating losses remain and 6.1x sales yields only 1.7% FCF; competition and dilution can absorb future operating leverage.

IRTC.rationale: 20% monitoring growth and improved cash generation support the path to profitability, but operating losses remain at 4.8x sales and a 1.0% FCF yield; reimbursement and commercial execution limit protection.

LASR.rationale: Laser demand and cash generation are recovering, but operating losses persist; 6.7x sales and a 2.0% FCF yield require durable defense/industrial growth and better margins.

AXGN.rationale: 23% growth and positive trailing cash flow support nerve-repair potential, but operating losses and dilution persist; 8.1x sales and a 0.4% FCF yield require a successful profitability transition.

HL.rationale: Silver/gold exposure currently generates strong cash and carries little reported debt, but 31x commodity-sensitive earnings is demanding; uneven quarterly/TTM revenue and incomplete coverage make the assessment provisional.

LIF.rationale: 38% growth supports location-sharing monetization, but recurring operating losses and earnings dominated by non-operating items weaken the 26x P/E; a 2.7% FCF yield is demanding for uncertain normalized margins.

INSM.rationale: 296% product growth and near quarterly operating break-even show progress, but $808m trailing cash burn and 17.8x sales require sustained launch success; funding needs and product concentration remain material.

GKOS.rationale: 50% growth and improving recent cash flow support glaucoma-treatment adoption, but trailing losses persist; 17x sales leaves substantial reimbursement, execution and dilution risk priced optimistically.

AXSM.rationale: 45.5% growth supports drug-commercialization potential, but operating losses and recurring cash burn remain substantial at 9.7x sales; product concentration and funding risk constrain the case.

GTLB.rationale: Developer-platform demand and cash generation have value, but growth slowed to 21% as quarterly operating losses widened; 9x sales and a 2.3% FCF yield leave little cushion for competitive disruption.

S.rationale: Cybersecurity revenue grows 21%, but large operating losses persist and cash generation is modest; 7.5x sales and a 0.7% FCF yield leave limited protection against competition and dilution.

AMBA.rationale: Imaging expertise and improving losses have value, but growth slowed to 13%, operating losses persist and 7x sales produces only a 0.3% FCF yield; commercialization remains uncertain.

KTOS.rationale: Defense demand supports 31% growth, but operating profitability is negligible and trailing FCF is negative; 238x earnings requires substantial program success and continued external capital discipline.

XMTR.rationale: 41% marketplace growth supports commercial relevance, but operating losses persist and trailing FCF remains negative; the capitalization requires substantial operating leverage despite debt, dilution and supplier/customer execution risk.

PL.rationale: Satellite-data growth is accelerating and cash flow has improved, but operating losses persist at 12.7x sales and a 0.5% FCF yield; satellite replacement costs, dilution and contract timing remain risks.

GH.rationale: 44% diagnostics growth supports commercial potential, but operating losses, cash burn and negative equity remain material; 19x sales prices a successful and capital-intensive path to sustainable profitability.

OUST.rationale: 56% lidar growth and narrowing losses support commercial progress, but trailing cash burn remains heavy at 9.6x sales; adoption, competition and dilution risks require more conservative expectations.

RKLB.rationale: 62% growth and improving launch/space-systems economics show promise, but 43x sales and substantial cash burn require major future execution; vehicle development, launch reliability and dilution remain risks.

TSLA.rationale: Manufacturing/energy capabilities and liquidity retain value, but flat revenue, weaker operating margins and a 0.25% FCF yield do not support 410x reported earnings without large unproven autonomy/robotics profits.

TPB.rationale: Nicotine-product growth is positive, but operating margins have fallen sharply and cash conversion is weak; 29x earnings and a 1.5% FCF yield leave regulatory, brand and working-capital risks insufficiently cushioned.

AMSC.rationale: 30% growth and newly positive operations are encouraging, but the apparent 8.7x P/E is dominated by profit far above operating income; a 1.7% FCF yield better reflects the demanding price.

FTAI.rationale: Aviation-services growth is strong, but margins fell sharply and positive earnings coexist with negative operating cash flow; 32x reported earnings and substantial leverage provide limited protection without normalized engine-investment economics.

OSCR.rationale: 70% insurance revenue growth and a profitability recovery are promising, but premium/claims timing makes the apparent 42% FCF yield misleading; medical costs, reserve adequacy and normalized underwriting profit are needed for valuation.

AFRM.rationale: 33% growth and improving operations are encouraging, but non-operating income overwhelms reported profit. The apparent 12x P/E cannot establish cheapness without normalized lender earnings and credit-loss analysis.
